name.description: Configuration for name on this Cloud Bigtable resource.
name.rationale: Terraform table name within the instance.

instance_name.description: Configuration for instance_name on this Cloud Bigtable resource.
instance_name.rationale: Which Bigtable instance hosts this table.

split_keys.description: !> **Warning:** Modifying the `split_keys` of an existing table will cause Terraform to delete/recreate the entire `google_bigtable_table` resource.
split_keys.rationale: Initial row-key splits for table creation; affects layout and recreate risk, not IAM.

column_family.description: Configuration for column_family on this Cloud Bigtable resource.
column_family.rationale: Declares column families on the table schema.

project.description: is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: GCP project ID where the table resource is managed.

deletion_protection.description: Configuration for deletion_protection on this Cloud Bigtable resource.
deletion_protection.rationale: Terraform-side guard against accidental destroy of the table resource.

change_stream_retention.description: Configuration for change_stream_retention on this Cloud Bigtable resource.
change_stream_retention.rationale: Setting this to "0" disables change history visibility used for monitoring and audit investigations.

automated_backup_policy.rationale: Automated backups support recoverability and incident response for table data.
automated_backup_policy.non-compliant: missing block, or retention_period = "0", or frequency = "0"

family.description: Configuration for family on this Cloud Bigtable resource.

type.description: Configuration for type on this Cloud Bigtable resource.
type.rationale: Table type variant when supported by the provider.
